description: Zombie Master: Reborn complete multiplayer content

sources.instructions: Obtain the official compatible complete Linux release. Source SDK scaffold alone does not contain the real mod. Stage the complete zombie_master_reborn/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

manual_reason: Manual full-distribution staging is required. These known file sentinels do not establish completeness; inspect the game-specific source instructions.
